version.changelog: First release: workflow, reference, template, working script and the Windows toolkit archive.

llm.summary: The skill leaves publication under user control, but its helper only checks text fields and cannot verify medical claims.

dimensions.detail: The helper reads the selected input and writes treatment-brief.md in the selected output directory. No network, credential access, broad indexing, or subprocess execution appears in the bundled code.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The Python workflow uses only the standard library. A separate unsigned Windows app is explicitly optional; its [publisher repository](https://github.com/rapidworker1/Multiple-AI-models-Toolkit) was checked, but the executable was not inspected.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions require provider approval, prohibit clinical protocols and invented results, and explicitly forbid automatic publication.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Only the local report persists. The bundled workflow requests no elevated privileges, background workers, startup hooks, or agent configuration changes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Agent instructions support drafting treatment pages. The helper only checks four fields for presence and length, and the supplied template lacks those fields.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Treat this as a drafting aid, not a compliance checker. The template needs adjustment for the helper, and provider review remains necessary before publication. The optional unsigned Windows app is unnecessary for this workflow and was not inspected; its listed hash does not establish safety.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Advisory concern downgraded to a functional limitation: drafting is assigned to the agent, while the helper performs basic checks. Its template mismatch and lack of claim verification need guidance but show no hidden authority.
[LP3] expected: Advisory concern overridden: local report writing is disclosed and proportionate. Missing tool-scope metadata alone does not establish excessive permissions.
